digest.component_or_area: jira reconciler live integration harness and mutation suite
propositions: An issue created in a real Data Center instance must appear in the local store after an inbound reconciliation pass, proven against a complete scrubbed copy of the actual production ticket store (not an empty fixture).
A local ticket edit must appear on the Data Center issue after an outbound reconciliation pass, with the mutation asserted individually against the DC REST API response.

The working repository used for testing must have zero git remotes and REBAR_SYNC_PUSH must be disabled, enforced by structural isolation (separate git init with no origin) and verified by test assertions.

The copied store must be completely scrubbed of all `.bridge_state*` artifacts and Jira identity bindings before any reconciliation pass, enumerated structurally rather than by hardcoded list, with count-matched verification against the source tickets branch.
Reconciliation must not plan any deletion mutations or outbound update mutations against the scrubbed store copy on the first pass, proven by inspecting the dry-run JSON envelope.

A multi-page inbound fetch must recover all seeded DC issues when the effective server page size is observed, 2*observed+1 issues are created to force multiple pages, and index lag is eliminated by polling before planning.
